title: The Legion in Rows
story: Twelve tidy rows of Glimmerfrost Imps marched across the frozen lake toward the fishing huts of Palewater, chittering in perfect step. Mr 6 knew imps melt in sunlight, and the clouds were breaking. He counted the ranks while the villagers stoked the signal fires.
question: There are 12 rows of 15 imps each, and when the sun breaks through exactly one quarter of them melt away; how many imps are still marching?
hint: Find the total army first with rows times columns, then work out what one quarter of that total is.
victory: Mr 6 marched the remaining 135 imps straight into the shadow of the ice cliff, where they froze into a very sparkly, very harmless garden fence. The villagers charge admission now.
imagePrompt: Neat rows of tiny glittering ice imps marching across a frozen lake as sunbeams pierce the clouds, with a numeral-six knight on a snowbank counting on his fingers.
praise: Multiplying rows by columns was a strong start — the missing step was subtracting the 45 melted imps from the total.
